meta.title: Parley — Record the meeting, then hand it to the AI you already use
meta.description: Parley is a free, open-source meeting recorder for Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android. The Mac captures both sides of a call and the phone records the room; the transcript arrives live and split by speaker, the debrief writes itself, and every recording is searchable. A built-in MCP server hands the whole library to Claude or whichever AI you use.
meta.ogTitle: Record the meeting. Then hand it to the AI you already use.
meta.ogDescription: A free, open-source meeting recorder: live transcript split by speaker, a debrief when it ends, search across everything — and an MCP server that hands it all to Claude or any AI you use. Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android.
meta.ogImageAlt: Parley: Record the meeting. Then hand it to the AI you already use. A live transcript with a blue waveform.
ld.features: Live transcript split by speaker, Both sides of a call on the Mac, In-person recording on the phone, Import existing recordings, A debrief shaped by the kind of meeting, Search across every recording, Automatic titles and filing, Built-in MCP server (54 tools), Your choice of transcription and model providers, Voice typing
hero.h1:
Record the meeting.
Then hand it to the AI you already use.
hero.sub: On a call, the Mac captures both sides; in the room, the phone on the table does. The transcript arrives live and split by speaker, the debrief writes itself — and then Claude, or whichever AI you use, can read, search and analyze every meeting you have.
hero.fine: Free. Sign in for hosted transcription with a free allowance that covers everyday use — or bring your own keys.
demo.alt: Illustration: a renewal meeting being transcribed live.
demo.line1: We're happy with the platform overall. The blocker is the seat count — we budgeted for forty and the quote came back at eighty.
demo.line2: Forty is the floor on the enterprise tier, so I can't go under it. What I can do is hold this year's price through the next renewal.
ask.label: Afterwards, ask your AI
ask.a: To hold this year's price through the next renewal, and send the revised quote by Thursday.
meetings.h2: Wherever the meeting happens, Parley records it.
room1.p: The Mac records your microphone and the meeting's system audio separately, so the other side never goes missing. The debrief adapts to the kind of meeting: internal, sales, pricing or competitive.
room1.alt: Parley on the desktop during a meeting: the live transcript on the left, coaching notes in the middle, the to-do list on the right
room2.p: Put the phone on the table; the transcript arrives while people are still talking, speakers separated. Recording never starts until you confirm everyone agreed.
room2.alt: The iPhone recording screen: a transcript for Speaker A and Speaker B, the waveform and an 18:47 timer
room3.p: A voice memo, an interview someone else recorded, last quarter's call — import the file and it's transcribed, filed alongside every other meeting and just as searchable.
room3.alt: The iPhone library: meetings by date, with upload markers and folders
after.h2: The debrief is written before you leave the room.
after.p: Shaped by the kind of meeting — internal, sales, pricing or competitive: where it landed, what each side committed to, what is still unclear, and what happens next. Every line carries a timestamp that plays back that exact moment.
after.alt: A Parley meeting report on the desktop: where it landed, commitments, what is still unknown and action items, each line with a timestamp
after.x1: ⌘K jump to any meeting or folder
after.x2: Auto title & filing it lands in the right folder
after.x3: Search everything down to a line said mid-meeting a year ago
ai.h2: The AI you already use can read every meeting.
ai.p: Parley runs a local MCP server. Point Claude, Cursor or any MCP client at it and it can read, search, file and re-analyze the whole library.
ai.a1: Three: Northwind renewal0:12, Halcyon discovery14:05, Meridian quarterly review22:40.
ai.q2: “What's still open on Halcyon's security questionnaire?”
ai.a2: Two items: data retention and the SSO provider — from the May 13 discovery call31:10.
ai.q3: “File this week's recordings into each customer's folder.”
ai.a3: Filed 4 recordings and created a folder, “Halcyon Labs”.
ai.codeComment: # Connect your MCP client — keep Parley open
ai.codeLabel: The command that adds Parley to Claude Code
ai.fine: No second AI key to set up inside Parley — connect the one you already pay for. The endpoint is local, so nothing leaves your machine to reach it.
ai.x1: 54 tools read, search, file, share and re-analyze
ai.x2: Self-hosted, too Parley's own analysis can run on your vLLM, LM Studio, LiteLLM or Ollama server
ai.x3: Hand over the analysis switch off auto-analysis and your agent reads the transcript, then writes findings and to-dos back into Parley
account.h2: Caught on the phone, picked up at the desk.
account.p: Every device signs in to the same account. The meeting you recorded on your phone in a customer's office is waiting on the desktop when you sit back down — transcript, debrief and timestamps, and your AI can read it too.
account.i1p: A meeting recorded without a connection queues on the phone and syncs itself once you're back online.
account.i2p: Keep a recording to yourself, or share or move it into your organization so the whole team sees every call with that customer.
account.i3p: The MCP server reaches recordings in your account, so Claude on the desktop can answer questions about the one you caught on the phone.
account.figLabel: Diagram: a meeting recorded on the phone travels through your account and opens on the desktop
voice.h2: The same transcription, typing into any app.
voice.p: Switch to the Parley keyboard on iPhone, or hold ⌥ Space on a Mac. AI polish takes out the filler, fixes punctuation and turns a spoken “first, second” into a list — without adding or summarizing anything.
voice.raw: so um before the Northwind meeting on Tuesday we need <s>like</s> three things, first the quote, second the uh security questionnaire, and then third the <s>the</s> onboarding timeline
voice.out:
Before the Northwind meeting on Tuesday we need three things:
  1. The quote
  2. The security questionnaire
  3. The onboarding timeline
voice.kIphone: iPhone Parley keyboard · Zhuyin · English suggestions · Action Button
voice.kDict: Dictionary fix a word once and it sticks
trust.h2: Your conversations go where you decide.
trust.t1p: Apache-2.0 — read it, fork it, host it.
trust.t2p: On the phone, nothing records until you confirm everyone agreed.
trust.t3p: The app reports no usage data. Recordings and transcripts stay on your devices and in your own account.
trust.t4p: Swap the transcription and the model, or point Parley at a server you host.
dl.p: Free on all four platforms. Start on the device you take most meetings on; add the rest later.
dl.free: Free. Sign in for hosted transcription with a free allowance that covers everyday use — or bring your own keys.
dl.windowsNote: On Windows, Parley records your microphone; capturing the other side of a call is Mac-only for now. The installer is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen shows a warning: click More info, then Run anyway.
